question: The 45 CONTROL-NOT-QUIET ability rows: what mechanism, and what happens when the instrument is corrected?

measured_before_the_prediction.note: these are readings off the existing artifact, not predictions

predictions.claim: The mechanism is ONE, not 45: board_state writes the carrier's ability onto both its active slot and its party row, the ability-swap control necessarily changes that field, and armDelta counts it. It is the Focus Sash item-leaf defect on the ability axis.
predictions.falsifier: a CONTROL-NOT-QUIET row whose minimum arm carries a leaf that is not the swap itself

predictions.claim: A value-conditioned ignore (drop an .ability leaf only when with==<ability under test> and without==<that arm's control ability>) plus normalising the control-arm ability value inside DKEY moves the ability roster to: FIRED-AND-BOARDS-MATCH 135, CONTROL-NOT-QUIET 14, COULD-NOT-STAGE 166, DEFERRED-BY-OWNER 1, total 316.
predictions.detail: 146 -> 134 as the 12 vacuous greens fall to COULD-NOT-STAGE; +1 because Trace is released; 45 -> 14 as 30 inert fixtures fall to COULD-NOT-STAGE and Trace is released

predictions.claim: Trace is the ONLY one of the 45 carrying a real ability-change leaf (with=pressure, i.e. it copied the foe's Pressure). Both engines agree on it, so Trace becomes FIRED-AND-BOARDS-MATCH and not a divergence.
No new FIRED-AND-BOARDS-DIFFER appears anywhere in the ability stage. The 45 are inert fixtures, not hidden engine defects, so this pass finds NO engine defect in medicham2-browser.js.
The 133 greens that already carry a non-ability leaf all keep their green.
predictions.falsifier: green count below 134 before Trace is added back

scored.P1: HIT — 45 of 45 rows had a control arm whose entire delta was the swap
scored.P2: PARTIAL MISS — FIRED 135 and CONTROL-NOT-QUIET 14 were exact; COULD-NOT-STAGE came out 162 not 166 and DEFERRED-BY-OWNER 5 not 1, because four owner deferrals (anticipation, forewarn, pickup, stall) were themselves hidden behind the same leaf: the shelf branch is gated on !sdMoved.length and the swap leaf kept sdMoved non-empty. The prediction did not know the shelf was invisible.
scored.P3: HIT — Trace was the only real ability-change leaf and it came out FIRED-AND-BOARDS-MATCH
scored.P4: HIT — 0 FIRED-AND-BOARDS-DIFFER before and after. No engine defect.
scored.P5: HIT — all 133 greens carrying a non-ability leaf kept their green; the 12 that fell are exactly the 12 named above
